items.title: Ransomware groups now exploiting JetBrains TeamCity flaw as 160+ servers remain unpatched
items.summary: JetBrains patched an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw (CVE-2026-63077) in TeamCity On-Premises, which lets attackers bypass authentication and run OS commands over HTTP/HTTPS. As of September 28, ransomware groups are actively exploiting it while Shadowserver tracks over 160 exposed servers still unpatched.

items.title: Pentagon breach exposes unknown number of troops' Social Security numbers
items.summary: The Defense Manpower Data Center found that unauthorized users accessed unencrypted personnel files between October 2025 and July 2026. Two people familiar with the incident estimated roughly 4 million Defense Department personnel may be affected, though the Pentagon has not confirmed a count.

items.title: Qilin and Doommageddon add fresh victims as ransomware claims surface
items.summary: Threat-intel monitors recorded new alleged victims on September 28: NISSHO Electric Manufacturing (Japan) claimed by Qilin and Goodrich Logistics claimed by Doommageddon. The listings remain threat-actor claims with no independent confirmation yet.

items.title: WordPress core flaw (CVE-2026-87902) exploited within hours of patch
items.summary: WordPress patched a critical unauthenticated local-file-inclusion flaw on September 22 that affects versions 4.7.0 through 7.1.1 and can lead to remote code execution. Attackers began probing sites within hours of the fix landing, prompting an immediate update to 7.1.2.

items.title: Check Point VPN RCE went from patch to exploit in three days
items.summary: Check Point confirmed active attacks against CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication CVSS 9.8 remote code execution flaw in VPN certificate handling on Security Gateways, just three days after releasing patches on September 9. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on September 22 with a September 25 federal remediation deadline.

items.title: Revolut customers hit by second data breach this month via DriveWealth
items.summary: Attackers socially engineered their way into US brokerage DriveWealth on September 4-5 and stole historic customer data, including names, emails, phone numbers, and postal addresses. Revolut says its own systems were not compromised and funds remain safe.
